properties.name: P1 TYPED_LOCAL_READOUT_CONTRACT
properties.description: Decision form, refusal, latency and proper-score measurements remain separate from semantic correctness and causal credit.
properties.adopted_measurement_contract: Decision form, refusal, latency and proper-score measurements remain separate from semantic correctness and causal credit.
properties.unproven_hswm_extension: A typed output contract does not implement permitted Step/Learn or semantic revision.

properties.name: P2 OUTCOME_CALIBRATION_MEASUREMENT
properties.description: Keep held-out outcome, calibration sample, model/relation version and evidence mass distinct.
properties.adopted_measurement_contract: Keep held-out outcome, calibration sample, model/relation version and evidence mass distinct.
properties.unproven_hswm_extension: Calibration is not outcome-bound canonical revision, truth, causal credit or learning.

properties.name: P3 SNAPSHOT_BATCH_SCHEDULING_CONTRACT
properties.description: Independent reads may share a frozen snapshot only with declared dependency and revision ordering.
properties.adopted_measurement_contract: Independent reads may share a frozen snapshot only with declared dependency and revision ordering.
properties.unproven_hswm_extension: Parallel scheduling does not establish shared computation, serializable writes or joint semantics.

properties.name: P4 CANDIDATE_AND_LOCAL_READ_CONTRACT
properties.description: Measure candidate recall, none/expand and information sufficiency against fixed-topology controls.
properties.adopted_measurement_contract: Measure candidate recall, none/expand and information sufficiency against fixed-topology controls.
properties.unproven_hswm_extension: Candidate construction does not discover topology or demonstrate adequate local information.

properties.name: P5 JOINT_NARY_CONSTRAINT_CONTRACT
properties.description: Represent role-bearing joint candidates or explicit factorization assumptions; test excluded states.
properties.adopted_measurement_contract: Represent role-bearing joint candidates or explicit factorization assumptions; test excluded states.
properties.unproven_hswm_extension: Marginal predictions do not establish a learned joint Semantic Weight disposition.

properties.name: P6 TWO_SCALE_COMPOSITION_CONTRACT
properties.description: Measure lower and upper interventions, lineage, exit and calibration under one typed contract.
properties.adopted_measurement_contract: Measure lower and upper interventions, lineage, exit and calibration under one typed contract.
properties.unproven_hswm_extension: Nested graphs or wrappers do not establish fractal cognition-bearing composition.

properties.name: RelationVersion
properties.description: Stored meaning is distinct from role/context-conditioned transition disposition.
properties.minimum_fields: schema version; lineage; atom UID; revision; schema-relative owner; semantic text; disposition; exception and evidence references
properties.distinction: Stored meaning is distinct from role/context-conditioned transition disposition.
properties.owner_lineage_obligation: Persistent, revisable or recoverable relation/incidence records require one schema-relative owner and their own revision lineage; this is a proposed contract, not runtime implementation.

properties.name: RoleParticipation
properties.description: Role exchange is distinct from enumeration-order change.
properties.minimum_fields: relation version; exact participant atom version; role; reference type; slot or ordinal
properties.distinction: Role exchange is distinct from enumeration-order change.
properties.owner_lineage_obligation: Persistent, revisable or recoverable relation/incidence records require one schema-relative owner and their own revision lineage; this is a proposed contract, not runtime implementation.

properties.name: ReadFrame
properties.description: Small input size is distinct from information sufficiency.
properties.minimum_fields: source snapshot; actual read-set and payload hash; context; omitted and added read requests
properties.distinction: Small input size is distinct from information sufficiency.
properties.owner_lineage_obligation: Persistent, revisable or recoverable relation/incidence records require one schema-relative owner and their own revision lineage; this is a proposed contract, not runtime implementation.

properties.name: DecisionContract / CandidateSet
properties.description: Candidate-normalized probability is distinct from candidate omission.
properties.minimum_fields: output type; ordered candidates; contract version; candidate scope; other/expand meaning
properties.distinction: Candidate-normalized probability is distinct from candidate omission.
properties.owner_lineage_obligation: Persistent, revisable or recoverable relation/incidence records require one schema-relative owner and their own revision lineage; this is a proposed contract, not runtime implementation.

properties.name: Execution / Prediction
properties.description: Repeated-call occurrence is distinct from equal content hash.
properties.minimum_fields: execution ID; frame; model/config; contract; request bytes; prediction; probability; refusal; cost
properties.distinction: Repeated-call occurrence is distinct from equal content hash.
properties.owner_lineage_obligation: Persistent, revisable or recoverable relation/incidence records require one schema-relative owner and their own revision lineage; this is a proposed contract, not runtime implementation.

properties.name: Outcome
properties.description: Observed outcome is distinct from prediction and self-explanation.
properties.minimum_fields: prediction or trace reference; observation source; event and record time; evaluation population
properties.distinction: Observed outcome is distinct from prediction and self-explanation.
properties.owner_lineage_obligation: Persistent, revisable or recoverable relation/incidence records require one schema-relative owner and their own revision lineage; this is a proposed contract, not runtime implementation.

properties.name: CalibrationArtifact
properties.description: Calibration parameter is distinct from semantic revision and causal credit.
properties.minimum_fields: fit population and split; model/relation/contract versions; method; temperature; evaluation scope
properties.distinction: Calibration parameter is distinct from semantic revision and causal credit.
properties.owner_lineage_obligation: Persistent, revisable or recoverable relation/incidence records require one schema-relative owner and their own revision lineage; this is a proposed contract, not runtime implementation.

properties.name: RevisionProposal / CommittedRevision
properties.description: Proposed, stored, semantic change and useful improvement are distinct.
properties.minimum_fields: parent version; bound trace and outcome; proposal; validation; commit result; semantic and evidence deltas
properties.distinction: Proposed, stored, semantic change and useful improvement are distinct.
properties.owner_lineage_obligation: Persistent, revisable or recoverable relation/incidence records require one schema-relative owner and their own revision lineage; this is a proposed contract, not runtime implementation.

properties.name: Inherited negative: four revisions changed no semantic fields
properties.description: The 2026-09-21 audit observed four committed revisions with zero semantic-field changes and an oracle/local semantic-execution bottleneck. It is preserved, not rerouted into support.
properties.reroute_rule: Do not use topology, batching or scale to rescue this upstream failure.

properties.name: OpenCog Hyperon comparator boundary
properties.description: Persistent metagraph and neural bridges are compared at the pinned audit maturity only; this graph neither executes Hyperon nor selects a backend.

properties.name: W1 Local semantic execution
properties.description: Priority diagnostic: frozen relation version; oracle/frozen/meaning-removed and role/exception interventions; equal information, model and cost; refusal-aware accuracy and probability-quality measurements.
properties.dependencies: Priority diagnostic: frozen relation version; oracle/frozen/meaning-removed and role/exception interventions; equal information, model and cost; refusal-aware accuracy and probability-quality measurements.
properties.failure_reroute: If oracle relations still fail, retain the failure, change information/encoding/model realization under a new protocol, and hold downstream topology/scale expansion.

properties.name: W2 Outcome revision separation
properties.description: May diagnose in parallel with W1: semantic delta, evidence delta, request delta; evidence-only/sham/remove/restore controls and fresh-process reuse. Any learning-efficacy judgment depends on an executable W1 condition.
properties.dependencies: May diagnose in parallel with W1: semantic delta, evidence delta, request delta; evidence-only/sham/remove/restore controls and fresh-process reuse. Any learning-efficacy judgment depends on an executable W1 condition.
properties.failure_reroute: If no semantic delta is observable, preserve the no-op; byte change alone is not success, and reroute to explicit revision mediation.

properties.name: W3 Local-read and candidate sufficiency
properties.description: May diagnose in parallel with W1: controlled full-context/fixed-read/adaptive-read budgets, candidate recall, none/expand and added-read cost; hidden outcomes remain unread.
properties.dependencies: May diagnose in parallel with W1: controlled full-context/fixed-read/adaptive-read budgets, candidate recall, none/expand and added-read cost; hidden outcomes remain unread.
properties.failure_reroute: If local reads alias distinct correct states or candidate recall is inadequate, correct the read/candidate contract and retest; confidence is not sufficiency.

properties.name: W4 Joint and batched execution
properties.description: Required W1–W3 conditions; allowed joint transitions and exclusion/complementarity/triple constraints; equal-cost serial/batch/actual-shared-compute protocol.
properties.dependencies: Required W1–W3 conditions; allowed joint transitions and exclusion/complementarity/triple constraints; equal-cost serial/batch/actual-shared-compute protocol.
properties.failure_reroute: If factorization violates a joint constraint or batching yields stale revisions, retain the failure and use explicit joint candidates or serialized stages; speed alone is not shared computation.

properties.name: W5 Two-scale composition
properties.description: W4 and both-scale typed Step/Learn, outcome, lineage, permission, conflict and exit witnesses.
properties.dependencies: W4 and both-scale typed Step/Learn, outcome, lineage, permission, conflict and exit witnesses.
properties.failure_reroute: If lower-scale effects or contracts fail to persist at upper scale, do not use downstream scale to rescue them; preserve the failure and revise the composition mechanism.

properties.name: Read contract
properties.description: A local LLM receives relation text, ordered typed roles, context, exceptions and evidence under an explicitly bounded read scope.

properties.name: Write contract
properties.description: A proposal is separate from a canonical write and has no admission, Permit or learning effect in this projection.

properties.name: Revision contract
properties.description: Observed outcome, semantic disposition, evidence mass, routing score and causal credit remain distinct.

properties.name: Projection contract
properties.description: RDF/PROV-O/SHACL/SPARQL are bounded read-only exchange and validation surfaces.
